source: ARBITRATION D0190 (third value): C004_obv.webp 4x zoom + https://en.numista.com/147 (Netherlands 5 Euro Cents KM# 236, row 2000 Bow and arrow with star, 184 200 000; Mint Royal Dutch Mint Utrecht caduceus). Left of 2000 is Erik Jan van Schouwenburg's bow and arrow with star (2000-2001) and right of 2000 is the Utrecht caduceus; grapes was 2001-2002.

ARBITRATION D0192 (third value): C010_rev.webp 4x zoom + https://en.numista.com/731 (Netherlands 25 Cents KM# 204, row 1996 Bow and arrow, 24 840 000; Mint Royal Dutch Mint Utrecht caduceus). Left of 1996 is Chris van Draanen's bow and arrow (not a star) and right of 1996 is the Utrecht caduceus.
